note: Every variant carries the SAME content as subs/torture.srt and must produce EXACTLY the cue list in subs/torture.expected.json. A decoder that assumes UTF-8 returns 0 cues from the UTF-16 files — silently, because an empty cue list is not an error.
rule: Sniff the byte-order mark before decoding: FF FE => UTF-16LE, FE FF => UTF-16BE, EF BB BF => UTF-8 with the BOM stripped, otherwise UTF-8. Do NOT trust the Content-Type: the real server labelled a UTF-16 sidecar `text/html` with no charset.

variants.why: FF FE — what the real server served. 50% null bytes.
FE FF — the other byte order; rarer but legal.
EF BB BF — decodes as UTF-8, but the BOM must not survive into the first cue's index line.

alsoAcceptsPlain: subs/torture.srt has no BOM and must still decode as UTF-8
